gaps.sentence: On the way to Rome we stopped ___ some photos.
gaps.hint: stop in order to do sth
gaps.explanation: stop to do = pause in order to do; stop doing = finish doing. Here they paused to take photos.

gaps.sentence: I want you ___ the truth, whatever it is.
gaps.explanation: want + object + to-infinitive: want you to tell.

gaps.sentence: Remember ___ your passport to the airport.
gaps.explanation: remember + to-infinitive = not forget to do something.

gaps.sentence: This new timetable will mean ___ earlier trains.

gaps.explanation: happen + to-infinitive = do something by chance: happen to know.

gaps.sentence: He was made ___ for the damage to the rental car.
gaps.explanation: In the passive, 'be made to do' takes the to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: We'd better not ___ the neighbours again.
gaps.explanation: had better + bare infinitive (not comes after better): better not disturb.
would rather takes the bare infinitive: I'd rather stay.
